name: PT Industri dan Perdagangan Bintraco Dharma Tbk
summary: PT Industri dan Perdagangan Bintraco Dharma Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the automotive business in Indonesia. The company operates through Financing, Automotive, and Aftersales segments. It sells motor vehicles; and offers sales and after-sales services, as well as provides financial services. The company is also involved in the trading and distribution of car and motorcycle parts, accessories, and services; provision of vehicle repair services; building rental activities; vehicle dealing business; and vehicle purchases, as well as operates an automotive workshop under the CarFix brand name.
